name: Published Document Metadata and Disclosure Review
description: Statically inspects a document the subject published or owns and lists what it discloses (author, software, GPS, URLs). Nothing is opened or executed.

inputs.name: evidence_id
inputs.label: Supplied by the 'Run with file' action

legal_notes: Only files the subject owns, published, or that are provided with documented authorization. GPS values are RESTRICTED.
quota_note: No network requests (works on local data)
example_output: A de-duplicated dataset saved as evidence, with every finding linked to its source response.
capability_gaps: Public-document URL import is not automated: download the file yourself and import it.
instructions: Statically inspects a document the subject published or owns and lists what it discloses (author, software, GPS, URLs). Nothing is opened or executed.

definition.name: Published Document Metadata and Disclosure Review
definition.description: Statically inspects a document the subject published or owns and lists what it discloses (author, software, GPS, URLs). Nothing is opened or executed.

config.prompt: Check the disclosure list: author names, device or software identifiers, GPS, embedded URLs and emails. Record which the subject should remove.
